threat_event: Client-issued EHR accounts left active after consultant roll-off are used to access PHI
threat_source: Departed consultant; attacker with harvested credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 6,300 client-issued accounts not inventoried; roll-off notices late
treatment_plan: Client account register; roll-off notice within 1 business day; quarterly reconciliation with clients

threat_event: Client PHI kept in the engagement repository and on laptops is exposed through sharing links or loss
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHI saved without classification; external sharing links allowed
treatment_plan: Automatic PHI detection and labels; block external links on labeled content; purge at engagement close

threat_event: A consultant-caused incident is reported to a client after the BAA deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 clients have 72-hour terms; notice register incomplete
treatment_plan: BAA terms register; join the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: An unpatched enclave desktop is exploited
Federal contract information leaves the enclave by email or personal devices
treatment_plan: Outbound email rule for agency markings

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consultants hold many client accounts with weaker client-side MFA
treatment_plan: Client-account phishing scenarios; push clients for MFA in contracts

threat_event: Consultants paste client confidential data or PHI into the generative AI assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved assistant allowed for drafting; PHI rules not technically enforced

threat_event: Denial-prediction model built on client PHI is reused beyond what client BAAs permit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model trained on pooled data from several clients
existing_controls: Legal review of first 12 client BAAs
treatment_plan: Per-client models unless the BAA permits data aggregation; BAA review for all clients

threat_event: Subcontracted consultants handle PHI without subcontractor BAAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 240 independent subcontractors; template lacks BAA terms

threat_event: Identity or laptop failure during a client go-live
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Go-lives depend on consultant laptops and SYS-G1

threat_event: Client payroll data downloaded to consultant laptops during HR system conversions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Conversion files handled outside client tenants
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) (third-party agent duties, worked example)
treatment_plan: Conversions only inside client tenants or the enclave pattern
owner: Workforce and HR Technology Consulting president

threat_event: Loss of an encrypted consultant laptop
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted devices are not a breach of unsecured PHI

threat_event: Federal Solutions consultants are not verified in E-Verify within the contract timeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assignment changes not flagged to onboarding

threat_event: Consultants forward client data to personal email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Forwarding rules not blocked for all mailboxes
